verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents multiple distribution paths: shared files/repos (SKILL.md in .claude/skills, GitHub repos), plugin marketplaces with centralized discovery/versioning/auto-updates, and CLI commands like `/plugin marketplace add` and `/plugin install` for team rollout, plus a verified real-world install of skills from a git repo by third-party tooling. missing for 10: independent enterprise case study of a team rolling out a shared skill set at scale, and clearer guidance on version pinning/conflict resolution across a large team.
